description: This file defines various warning collector functions related to group policy configurations, including functions for composing, projecting, and building warnings for open policies, allowlists, route allowlists, and account-specific policies within a plugin system.

methods.name: composeWarningCollectors
methods.description: Creates a combined warning collector from multiple collectors, flattening their results.

methods.name: projectWarningCollector
methods.description: Projects parameters before passing to a warning collector.

methods.name: projectConfigWarningCollector
methods.description: Projects parameters with a config object for warning collection.

methods.name: projectConfigAccountIdWarningCollector
methods.description: Projects parameters with config and optional accountId for warning collection.

methods.name: projectAccountWarningCollector
methods.description: Projects parameters to extract account info for warning collection.

methods.name: projectAccountConfigWarningCollector
methods.description: Projects parameters with account and config, transforming config before warning collection.

methods.name: createConditionalWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a warning collector that conditionally includes warnings based on multiple collectors.

methods.name: composeAccountWarningCollectors
methods.description: Combines a base account warning collector with additional account-specific collectors.

methods.name: buildOpenGroupPolicyWarning
methods.description: Constructs a warning message for open group policies.

methods.name: buildOpenGroupPolicyRestrictSendersWarning
methods.description: Builds a warning message for restricting senders in open policies.

methods.name: buildOpenGroupPolicyNoRouteAllowlistWarning
methods.description: Builds a warning for open policies with no route allowlist.

methods.name: buildOpenGroupPolicyConfigureRouteAllowlistWarning
methods.description: Builds a warning for configuring route allowlists in open policies.

methods.name: collectOpenGroupPolicyRestrictSendersWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings when open group policies restrict senders.

methods.name: collectAllowlistProviderRestrictSendersWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings for allowlist provider restrict senders based on current policy.

methods.name: createAllowlistProviderRestrictSendersWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a warning collector for allowlist provider restrict senders, account-aware.

methods.name: createOpenGroupPolicyRestrictSendersWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a direct account-aware warning collector for restrict senders policy.

methods.name: collectAllowlistProviderGroupPolicyWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings based on allowlist provider group policy.

methods.name: createAllowlistProviderGroupPolicyWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a config-aware warning collector from a policy resolver.

methods.name: collectOpenProviderGroupPolicyWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings for open provider group policies.

methods.name: createOpenProviderGroupPolicyWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a config-aware warning collector for open provider policies.

methods.name: createAllowlistProviderOpenWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates an account-specific warning collector for open policies.

methods.name: collectOpenGroupPolicyRouteAllowlistWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings for route allowlist configurations in open policies.

methods.name: createAllowlistProviderRouteAllowlistWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates an account-specific warning collector for route allowlist warnings.

methods.name: collectOpenGroupPolicyConfiguredRouteWarnings
methods.description: Collects warnings for configured route allowlists.

methods.name: createOpenProviderConfiguredRouteWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates an account-specific warning collector for configured route warnings.
